description: BITB-059 Phase 2 — keys that exist on exactly one side of the localized book-name contract between tests/fixtures/localized_book_map.json (the client-bundle map, consumed by web/Android) and api/utils/translation_registry.py's derived reverse map (the backend's per-translation-code master). api/tests/test_localized_book_map_registry_parity.py enforces that every one-sided key is listed here, and that no listed key has silently become shared (or vice versa) — so a new gap can't ship without a reviewed decision. Regenerate this fixture's key lists from a fresh diff (never hand-transcribe) whenever a test failure reports an unlisted key.

gaps.reason: English abbreviations/short forms in ENGLISH_ALIASES (translation_registry.py) that have not yet been propagated to the client bundle map.

Localized book names that happen to be spelled identically to English (e.g. German/French 'Job', 'Joel', 'Amos') appear as identity entries in the registry's per-language reverse maps. Clients already recognise the plain English form via LOCALIZED_BOOK_TO_ENGLISH's value union (getKnownBooks()), so no separate client-map key is needed for these.
Russian dative-case citation forms in RUSSIAN_ALIASES not yet propagated to the client bundle map (Phase 2b).
Chinese source-feed artifacts in CHINESE_ALIASES (BOM-prefixed Simplified Genesis, canonical Traditional Revelation) that only the backend ingest path needs to recognise.

Russian genitive-case citation forms the client bundle recognises but RUSSIAN_CITATION_FORMS/RUSSIAN_ALIASES do not yet carry (Phase 2b — adding these widens verse_parser.py's ALL_BOOK_NAMES regex and needs its own review against scripts/audit_book_name_coverage.py).
Alternate Russian dative-suffix citation forms the client bundle recognises but the registry does not (Phase 2b).
Arabic numbered-book forms the client bundle recognises but ARABIC_CITATION_FORMS does not yet carry (Phase 2b).
